text: Except for shift counts and incoming flags, data operands annotated `[iN]` shall have type `iN` after alias resolution and their primary result shall have type `iN`. Flags shall be explicit `i1` SSA values, with one indicating the named condition; operations shall not read/write implicit processor flags.
